snapshot_rule: materialize the Git tree and canonical memory events at or before each query_cutoff_commit

registered_factor_only.reason: measure the value and leakage risk of a curated summary separately

unitization.markdown: heading section with direct body; child sections are separate; preserve heading path in hidden locator
unitization.project_memory: one active or historically valid event per unit; superseded events remain available for temporal gold
unitization.catalog: one data row per unit with frozen column order
unitization.oversize: split only at deterministic paragraph boundaries under a UTF-8 byte ceiling chosen on development and frozen before test
unitization.exact_duplicates: collapse identical search_text hashes into one ranked unit and preserve every source alias
unitization.near_duplicates: preserve and report; do not tune a similarity deduplicator on test

pending_before_execution: freeze UTF-8 byte ceiling on outcome-hidden development
implement and test historical Git-tree reconstruction
verify no test query log or label path enters any unit
